follow-up time: Duration of pregnancy and at least 6 months postpartum
cohort: 43 female kidney transplant patients of reproductive age (18-40 years) who registered a pregnancy following kidney transplantation between 1987 and 2011
finding: Pregnancy in renal transplant recipients is associated with a high risk of complications, including preterm delivery, preeclampsia, and kidney rejection.
mod_finding: 82% of the patients had a cesarean section delivery.
